results.title: Funded Research - Wharton AI & Analytics Initiative
results.content: Recently, Wharton AI and Analytics Initiative funded a project to study “Reducing Gender and Racial Disparities in the Use of Generative AI in the Workplace.” While this research intends to enhance both academic research and practice over the longer-term, there is an immediate need to ensure that the “digital divide” in AI adoption does not manifest (or widen) among students enrolled in the courses, MGMT 2240 and MGMT 6240, Leading Diversity in Organizations. This research project aims to investigate the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) investments by non-tech firms (AI-adopters) on product market competition, innovation, and industry dynamics. With proprietary data from Upwork Inc., the researchers are able to access full information on a large sample of jobs and workers over time, thus obtaining findings that can inform the effects of generative AI on the labor market and careers.
